searches.reason: Test whether random interior masking transfers poorly to next-item prediction. Explore joint masked-item and terminal-mask training within one BERT4Rec model, with targets always hidden and appended-mask inference preserved. Compare using the fixed macro validation HR@10; training margins alone cannot establish generalization.

searches.reason: Investigate stronger discrimination among plausible candidates, especially in Industrial_and_Scientific and Electronics, where measured negative margins are more frequent. Seek efficient sampled-softmax and hard-negative objectives with false-negative safeguards, using only training interactions and one jointly trained BERT4Rec network per category.
searches.query: BERT4Rec sequential recommendation 2024 2025 2026 hard negative sampling sampled softmax false negatives next item ranking

searches.reason: Explore a content-aware BERT4Rec backbone that learns specific item relationships and recent intent from available titles, descriptions, and timestamps. Favor lightweight text encoders trained from scratch and jointly learned temporal attention; assess whether these improve specific matches without assuming unavailable compatibility labels or user traits.
searches.query: content aware BERT4Rec 2024 2025 2026 jointly trained title description encoder temporal attention recent intent sequential recommendation without pretrained embeddings
